topPRs.title: fix(op-service/txplan): Handle nonce-too-low errors in tx submission retry loop
topPRs.author: geoknee
topPRs.body:
When SendTransaction fails with ErrNonceTooLow (e.g., a deposit tx advanced the account nonce), invalidate the Nonce node to trigger re-evaluation of the entire signing pipeline on the next retry attempt.

Closes https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20345

topPRs.title: feat(rollup-boost): vendor rollup-boost in to the monorepo
topPRs.author: einar-oplabs
topPRs.body:
Continuation of #20466.

`rollup-boost` was previously a submodule under `./rollup-boost` from an external provider.

This PR vendors version tag `rollup-boost/v0.7.11` and brings it under the `monorepo:/rust`.

It is not a member of the rust workspace for now.
